newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares slip, seen marking time.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares slip, seen marking time.

text.p: Slovenian shares slipped 0.17 percent on Monday and traders expect shares to show little movement this week.
"The market was calm today as most traders are sidelined by the (general) elections. This could continue until the end of the week," Zmavc Franci, a trader at brokerage Intara said.
Slovenia is scheduled to hold general elections on November 10.
* The SBI index rose 2.01 points to 1,190.1.
* Turnover slumped to 107.7 million tolars from 231.4 million.
* Overall nine shares fell, three rose and one was unchanged, while 11 were untraded. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
